name: 📚︱books
topic:
If you like books, with or without words, on paper or in electrons, then you might just be in the right place!

If you want to discuss books _in general_, then drop in to the general discussion thread right here: https://discord.com/channels/1055290132250501135/1186057931775541298 In this thread, we try to avoid spoiling things for others. Please be considerate and if something you want to say is likely to be a spoiler, then consider using spoiler tags (https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360022320632-Spoiler-Tags-) to hide it for people who don't want to see it. Don't forget to add some context before or after the spoiler so people know to avoid it if they need to! ||Otherwise, how would they know the black block is a spoiler and not the world's funniest joke?||

If you want to discuss a specific book (series or otherwise) in detail, then you can also use a separate thread. We already have many existing threads, and we ask that you use one of those if it exists. If not, then please don't hesitate to create a new one! You can do so by starting a new thread right here. Name your thread following this pattern: "[Book or series title] - [Author]". For example, "Middle-earth - J. R. R. Tolkien" or "The Carpet People - Terry Pratchett" or "Exiles - Melanie Rawn". Consider adding a cover or poster for the book to your post starting the thread by clicking the image placeholder on the right and uploading one. In the book (series) specific threads we don't explicitly allow or ban spoilers, but beware that others may be posting spoilers. If you do not want spoilers for the topic of the thread, it is safer to avoid reading the thread. However we leave it to you to decide if you want to take the risk.

name: 📊︱user-monitoring
topic:
This forum is a shared space for documenting notable member activity that may benefit from additional awareness, follow-up, or coordinated support. Entries should focus on observable behavior, activity patterns, significant changes, unresolved interactions, verification needs, or other circumstances relevant to moderation. The purpose is not solely to identify bad actors, but to maintain a context-based awareness list that helps moderators recognize patterns, share relevant information, and respond consistently and appropriately.

**Available Tags:**

* **Escalation Risk:** Activity or behavior suggests the situation may worsen or require higher-level review
* **Behavioral Pattern:** Repeated conduct, conflict, boundary issues, or rule-related activity
* **Activity Change:** A notable or unexpected change in participation, tone, frequency, or behavior
* **Concerning Interaction:** A specific exchange or incident warrants additional awareness
* **Wellness Concern:** Observed activity suggests that a member may need support or a welfare check
* **Needs Follow-Up:** A pending issue, request, report, or conversation requires further attention
* **Verification Needed:** Claims, identity, circumstances, or reported information should be checked
* **Monitor Activity:** No immediate action is required, but continued observation is appropriate
* **Support Needed:** The member has expressed or demonstrated a need for guidance, resources, or accommodation
* **Do Not Engage Alone:** Staff should coordinate before contacting or responding to the member
* **Resolved:** The concern has been addressed and no further monitoring is currently needed
